info.name: GlazeAudio API
info.description:
Demonstrates all 15 GlazeAudio API methods (5 per resource: albums → songs → reviews), user accounts linked to their reviews, pagination, filtering, hypermedia links, the album overview, and the 400 / 404 / 422 / 201 / 204 cases.

Run the whole collection with the Runner (or `postman collection run`). It creates its own user, album, song and review, then deletes them, so it can be re-run any number of times.

exec: // Unique name per run, so the collection can be re-run without 409 conflicts
pm.test("Location header points to new user", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/users/" + b.id));
pm.test("New accounts get the User role", () => pm.expect(b.role).to.eql("User"));
pm.test("Returns a page of users", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(b).to.include.keys("page","pageSize","totalCount","totalPages","_links"); });
pm.test("Each user links to their reviews", () => pm.expect(b.items[0]._links.reviews.href).to.include("/reviews"));
pm.test("Returns a page of seeded albums", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(b).to.include.keys("page","pageSize","totalCount","totalPages","_links"); });

pm.test("Each album has fields and hypermedia links", () => { pm.expect(b.items[0]).to.include.keys("id","title","artist","releaseYear","genre","songCount","reviewCount","averageRating","_links"); pm.expect(b.items[0]._links).to.include.keys("self","update","delete","songs","overview"); });
pm.test("Location header points to new album", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/albums/" + b.id));
pm.test("Body echoes the album", () => pm.expect(b.title).to.eql("In Rainbows"));
pm.test("Overall rating is the average of 4 aspects", () => pm.expect(b.overallRating).to.eql(4.5));

body.raw:
{
  "userId": {{userId}},
  "lyricsRating": 4,
  "melodyRating": 5,
  "moodRating": 5,
  "expressivenessRating": 4,
  "comment": "The layered guitars build into something huge by the end."
}

exec: pm.test("Has one review", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.totalCount).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Rating and comment updated", () => { pm.expect(b.lyricsRating).to.eql(5); pm.expect(b.updatedAt).to.not.be.null; });

request.description: A client can start here and discover the rest of the API by following _links.

exec: pm.test("Has next link, no prev link", () => { pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("next"); pm.expect(b._links).to.not.have.property("prev"); });
pm.test("Now on page 2 with a prev link", () => { pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b._links).to.have.property("prev"); });

request.description: The URL comes from the previous response's _links.next - the client never builds it itself.

item.name: Filter - albums by genre and year

exec: pm.test("Every album matches the filter", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; b.items.forEach(a => { pm.expect(a.genre.toLowerCase()).to.include("rock"); pm.expect(a.releaseYear).to.be.at.least(1990); }); });
pm.test("Filters are kept in paging links", () => pm.expect(b._links.self.href).to.include("genre=rock"));
pm.test("Finds the album created by this run", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(a => a.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("albumId"))));

item.name: Hypermedia - follow the album's songs link

exec: pm.test("Each song links to its reviews", () => pm.expect(b.items[0]._links.reviews.href).to.include("/reviews"));

request.description: URL taken from _links.songs of the POST create album response.

exec: pm.test("All songs are at least 300 s long", () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.durationSeconds).to.be.at.least(300)));

item.name: Filter - reviews by author and minimum rating

exec: pm.test("Only matching reviews", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; b.items.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("testUsername")); pm.expect(r.overallRating).to.be.at.least(4); }); });
pm.test("Only admins", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; b.items.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.role).to.eql("Admin")); });

pm.test("Lists the review with its song and album", () => { pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].albumTitle).to.eql("In Rainbows"); pm.expect(b.items[0].songTitle).to.eql("Weird Fishes / Arpeggi"); });
pm.test("Links back to the review", () => pm.expect(b.items[0]._links.self.href).to.include("/reviews/" + pm.collectionVariables.get("reviewId")));

request.description: A user's profile view of their reviews, built from User, Review, Song and Album.

exec: pm.test("Top-rated song is the reviewed song", () => pm.expect(b.topRatedSong.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("songId"))));
